answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using a zero-knowledge attestation bridge over chip-signed electronic passports. A lantern verifier checks each proof's scoped nullifier against cedar policy rules to issue one credential per passport without exposing personal data. Attackers must acquire scarce physical passports or pay human proxies for every fake identity. However, credential-leasing markets allow attackers to rent verified proofs from willing human holders at scale.
